summary: Deliver mission escalation stages through native messages and person asks with durable episode deduplication.

replay.detail: Canonical transition and progress receipts name escalation episodes. Native message and person-ask receipts own delivery deduplication; a local restart index retains terminal ladders until their last deadline.

schema.detail: Adds the local_escalation_runs_v1 restart index and rebuildable local_escalation_clocks_v1 episode projection with local_escalation_pending_v1 change capture; existing escalation declarations are unchanged.

rules.detail: No automatic deployment or policy publication.

compatibility.detail: Publishing escalation declarations requires signed mission-escalation-v1=1 feature advertisements from every active anchored member. Missing or older readers refuse publication, including direct mission.published claims.

manual.detail: Upgrade or fence every reader before publishing escalation policies. Every overdue stage is delivered in declaration order; since-progress honors declared waits until expiry or explicit resume, while since-entered retains the state-entry episode. Evaluation uses bounded indexed episode lookups independent of subject history length.

recovery.detail: Keep native delivery receipts when restarting. Remove escalation declarations and republish before rolling back to a reader without escalation support.
